title: Hotgraphic
body: Select each marked point on the diagram to learn what happens at that stage.
instruction: Select each hotspot to show more information.

_items.title: Experience
_items.body: Something happens — a seminar, a draft, a piece of feedback. This is the raw material you will reflect on.

_items.title: Reflect
_items.body: Look back: what happened, what you did, and how it went. Describe before you judge.

_items.title: Make sense
_items.body: Connect it to what you know — a model, feedback, a criterion — to work out why it went that way.

_items.title: Apply
_items.body: Decide one thing to do differently next time, and name when you'll try it.
